entries.acceptance: Continue a research task from browser to chat without a second identity, separate memory reset or duplicate commitment.
An Evolution or voice transport adapter neither calls an unmediated executor nor owns constitution state.
A second identity cannot gain owner access by changing a sender parser, app parameter or connector account.
Product flows preserve the stated boundaries and refuse escalation through another model or surface.
A speculative browser idea becomes an open idea, not an active engineering task or a purchase authorization.
Ambiguous dates or names remain flagged and unresolved ambiguity blocks consequential actions.
Replaying an import produces no duplicate idea and a merged view still links both source conversations.
The idea vault answers what was discussed and not pursued, with evidence and explicit coverage gaps.
A week of missed workouts does not rewrite the training goal or deactivate it.
The owner sees which goal version informed a past plan and why the current version differs.
A one-day exception expires without weakening the next day or expanding tool permissions.
A reset removes learned delivery preferences without erasing legitimate commitments or security records.
A restricted known record is withheld without changing its epistemic state into missing or inferred.
Untrusted website instructions never become an owner preference or standing permission.
A changed address supersedes the applicable old record and does not delete unrelated historical addresses.
Deleting a source marks or removes dependent summaries and search indexes according to the retention policy.
A successful shipment workflow creates a procedure candidate but cannot teach itself a new credential or authority scope.
A late wake-up reflows flexible work and buffers while preserving an unchanged appointment.
Read receipts, ignored reminders, task expiry and phone inactivity do not complete a task.
Repeated misses create a minimum viable action or recovery plan, not punitive actions or automatic goal deletion.
DST and travel changes do not duplicate reminders or turn a historic bedtime into a permanent anchor.
No useful items means zero unsolicited interruptions. Grouping and quiet periods preserve open commitments.
A disconnected phone does not remain driving indefinitely or authorize actions using yesterday's location.
Re-importing meals, photos or app events produces one logical history with explicit revised derivations.
The system never invents feelings from low recovery, slow replies or a calendar event.
A question about a month with only one week of tracking receives a coverage-qualified answer.
Search, summaries and caches stop revealing a revoked private source after its deletion workflow completes.
A cross-owner record is rejected and missing essential evidence produces a clarification rather than fabricated confidence.
Editing one byte without changing the version changes the assembly digest or fails the build.
A large owner message or metadata expansion is measured and denied or reduced through an explicit policy before inference.
An invented evidence ID or model-supplied approval field is rejected.
A crash after request creation does not become permanent silent duplicate success, and unknown model dispatch is reconciled.
Provider outage never activates an unapproved paid or less-private fallback.
The model cannot nominate another owner, claim approved=true, or manufacture a trusted resolver reference.
An incomplete or unknown executor is not admitted simply because it has an MCP tool name.
A WhatsApp message saying yes cannot approve a changed or expired high-impact snapshot.
Concurrent attempts cannot overspend a use count, wildcard targets fail, and HIGH_IMPACT operations cannot run under standing leases.
A queued action approved before revocation is denied when dispatch begins afterward.
New names or model routes cannot bypass the prohibition, and documentation generation never enables payment tools.
A fatigue signal proposes lower interruption load or review, not automatic authority expansion.
Crash after acknowledgement leaves recoverable canonical work, not a lost message.
Rescheduling invalidates an old callback without confusing a job deadline with a commitment deadline.
A send timeout becomes reconciliation-required, not sent or automatically retried under a fresh operation key.
Voice interruption stops speech but does not erase a previously sent email or claim it was canceled.
Restoring a backup does not resend previously accepted external effects.
Spoofed request owner fields and unenrolled WhatsApp LIDs fail before Brain invocation.
A revoked device loses access and cannot use an old session or challenge to reenroll itself.
A camera permission does not permit background upload or inclusion of intimate images in routine prompts.
No model transcript or stored credential substitutes for recording consent.
An owner sees which sensors and sources are active and can stop collection without disabling audit inspection.
A disabled Evolution connection does not block basic owner access to JARVIS.
Unknown senders, history-sync traffic, group messages and unenrolled aliases do not become owner commands.
FRIDAY shortens delivery, mentor changes explanation, and EDITH selection alone does not enable a writer.
A phone and desktop show the same canonical task and the exact action requiring approval.
A network reconnect resumes the pending outcome rather than starting a new send.
Barge-in after dispatch leaves an observable pending or uncertain external outcome.
Bad transcription of a recipient requires clarification and a cost or privacy failure never silently switches providers.
Recorded or synthesized speech cannot resolve a protected approval.
Revoked devices fail ingress and stale local queues cannot overwrite newer canonical state.
A denied capability remains unavailable without screenshot or accessibility workarounds to evade the denial.
An expired bedtime rule cannot keep an app blocked indefinitely and essential emergency access remains available.
Test reports name device, OS, permissions and measured outcomes rather than extrapolating from a demo.
A manifest missing authentication or retention fails admission.
Offline replay and edits do not double-count meals, work hours, workouts or income observations.
A training recommendation cites current source data without becoming a diagnosis or changing the owner program silently.
A warehouse discrepancy yields linked records and a proposed procedure, not unreviewed Seller Central mutations.
A shared view never implicitly makes another person a JARVIS owner or exposes unrelated private data.
A trip or timesheet summary distinguishes manual estimates from measured events and media logs store licensed metadata, not audio copies.
A later WhatsApp question continues a research thread without fabricated source recall.
A website instruction cannot order submission, upload private files or activate a payment workflow.
Compatibility reports distinguish tested platforms, constrained platforms and unimplemented targets.
Research never expands worker credentials or overwrites the protected engineering instructions.
Repeated no-progress steps stop even while a global budget has funds.
A delegated agent cannot bypass a denied parent action by using another connector.
A canceled worker preserves pending effect reconciliation and cannot mark its own objective complete without evidence.
A new skill cannot introduce credential reads, unrestricted commands or new contact scopes.
A temporary night rule cannot become standing permission through repeated use.
An urgent-looking message cannot trigger money movement, sensitive disclosure or self-approved external communication.
The brief never summarizes queued work as completed.
A week without interaction preserves data and parks sensitive actions instead of granting emergency powers.
A restore drill proves canonical relationships and prohibits automatic replay of pending external writes.
A writer fails its release gate if stop propagation, credential independence or recovery behavior is unproven.
An unauthorized-send incident preserves the exact revision and unknown outcomes before any replay or cleanup.
A stale phone clock or long lock wait cannot extend a lease beyond the trusted deadline.
A healthy HTTP endpoint with an unprocessed outbox is reported as degraded, not fully healthy.
Credential-bearing verification never runs arbitrary candidate install hooks or tests.
The planner lists collisions and excluded machine configs rather than overwriting them.
A memory task gets its own requirements and does not load the entire PRD or privileged connector data.
A new session identifies the next authorized mission without reconstructing history from chat.
A forged completed flag in ROADMAP or STATE cannot admit a later mission.
Dummy drills reject a revoked key, a repeated recovery nonce and an old trust epoch.
A draft cannot become active by changing its filename, and an active consumer blocks retirement.
A passing pack test does not certify deployment, isolation or real application concurrency.
